name: clinical-trial-portal-next
description: Grace Commons Demo 2 — second render (Next.js App Router + PostgreSQL + RSC). Same compositions, action codes, and hash-chain contract as demos/clinical-trial-portal (Deno+SQLite). See BUILD_PLAN.md.

comments.driver: BUILD_PLAN Decision 1 specified postgres.js; we use node-postgres (pg) + @electric-sql/pglite behind one query(text,params) seam (lib/db.ts). Both are raw-SQL (no ORM — honors A.14/Decision 1); pglite is the zero-setup embedded default (a single in-process backend = the §4 single-writer model), pg is used when DATABASE_URL points at a real server. Logged in CORNERS.md.
comments.password: @node-rs/argon2 (BUILD_PLAN Decision 4) is added in the composition step; if its native binary is unavailable, lib/password.ts falls back to node:crypto scrypt with a CORNERS note (conformance does not check the password method; cross-render PHC interop is the only thing lost).
